svg.text: Domino Data Lab 6.3 on Google Cloud Platform (GKE 1.35) — Reference Architecture
Project: your-gcp-project-id (123456789012) | 4 Horizontal Layers Stacked Top-to-Bottom: Ingress -> Platform Control Plane -> Compute Grid -> Shared Storage & CMEK
GCP PROJECT: your-gcp-project-id | CUSTOM VPC: domino-gcp (10.138.0.0/20) | GKE 1.35 STABLE CHANNEL
LAYER 1 (TOP BAND) — EXTERNAL HTTPS INGRESS, CLOUD DNS, TLS TERMINATION & NETWORK POLICY (dns.tf | k8s/02)
LAYER 2 (SECOND BAND) — PRIVATE GKE 1.35 CONTROL PLANE & DOMINO PLATFORM TIER (gke.tf | Namespaces: domino-platform & domino-system)
LAYER 3 (THIRD BAND) — ELASTIC COMPUTE GRID, DISTRIBUTED HPC CLUSTERS & IMAGE BUILDERS (node_pools.tf | Namespace: domino-compute)
• Boot Disk: 400 GB pd-balanced (10x Image Rule)
• IDEs: JupyterLab, Jupyter, RStudio, VS Code
• Apps: Flask, FastAPI, Streamlit, Shiny, Dash
• Optional Nexus Remote Data Plane Support
LAYER 4 (BOTTOM BAND) — PERSISTENT STORAGE, ARTIFACT REGISTRY, WORKLOAD IDENTITY & CLOUD KMS CMEK (storage.tf | gcr.tf | kms.tf)
• Backs Domino Datasets, DFS & Shared Blobs
